dateline: BTS won Song of the Year for 'SWIM', Best K-Pop and Best Group at the 2026 MTV VMAs (Sept 27 US time), skipping the ceremony. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said Sept 24 that she expects BTS in Mexico in 2027; HYBE has not confirmed. The ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá on Oct 2-3.
heroHeadline: Day 4,854: BTS Sweep MTV VMAs, Winning Song of the Year for 'SWIM'
heroSubtitle: September 27, 2026 is Day 4,854 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. BTS won all three categories they were nominated for at the 2026 MTV VMAs in Los Angeles — Song of the Year for 'SWIM', Best K-Pop and Best Group (their fifth) — without attending the ceremony. The ARIRANG World Tour's Latin American leg opens in Bogotá, Colombia on Oct 2-3, followed by Lima, Santiago, La Plata and São Paulo.
